Manchester United are third from bottom of the Premier League. Their answer? Mauricio Pochettino.
Michael Carrick was sacked after the club's worst ever Premier League start, less than six months into a two year deal.
The case for: he took Tottenham to a Champions League final, and his teams press high and trust young players.
The case against: in over fifteen years as a manager, he's won one league title, in France. And at Chelsea, he lasted a single season.
His first job at Old Trafford isn't a trophy. It's survival.
So, will Pochettino succeed? Tell me in the comments.
